Hi Natalie,

Thanks again for taking time today — enjoyed the walkthrough and the frank discussion about timelines. Per our call I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (RWI_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) focused on the security review / SOC 2 package milestone. Key items I captured:

- Security review kickoff: target week of 4/12 — Redwood security + FinClear security deep-dive (30–45m)
- SOC 2 questionnaire response: Redwood to provide completed questionnaire draft by 4/16
- Evidence collection handoff: owners and file list by 4/20 (we recommend Marissa own collection; Karthik to support technical artifacts)
- Final evidence bundle delivery (zip + index): target 5/03 to support your auditor intake

Open questions for you:
1) Would you prefer the questionnaire as a PDF form (we attached v2) or a tracked Word doc?
2) Who on your side will own receiving the evidence items (name + email) so we can map the checklist?

Next steps from our side: Marissa will coordinate the evidence checklist and Karthik will enumerate the technical artifacts (logs, config snapshots, runbooks). If that plan sounds right I'll lock dates in the MAP and share the Drive link.

Thanks —
